config.target: INS versus DEL; within-type AP/AUROC are undefined
config.primary_interaction: high minus low native graph complexity in strict context
config.endpoint_complexity: maximum category at the two manuscript endpoint coordinates; start-only sensitivity
config.size_bins: retain existing HGSVC length_bin without outcome-dependent merging
config.frequency_bins: retain existing HGSVC af_bin; separate AC=1 count stratum
config.pvalue: exact two-sided sign flips of seed-averaged fold gains, descriptive under CV dependence
config.multiple_testing: BH within each context and stratification family, all prespecified estimable strata retained
config.bootstrap: existing paired 10000-draw chromosome-fold then seed method

donor_inference: Descriptive; correlated carriers of shared variants, chromosome-held-out pooled probe
confidence_intervals: Pointwise hierarchical fold/seed bootstrap; not multiplicity-adjusted
q_values: BH separately within family/context/metric; sign flips of five seed-averaged folds
class_metrics: Within INS or DEL, class recall replaces undefined discrimination metrics
